details.description: Llama 3.2 11B Vision Instruct is the smaller multimodal model in Meta's Llama 3.2 collection, released September 25, 2024, adding a separately trained vision adapter with cross-attention layers to the Llama 3.1 language model so it can reason over images alongside text. It has a 128K-token context window and is instruction-tuned for visual question answering, document understanding, image captioning, and chart or diagram interpretation, with a knowledge cutoff of December 2023. Amazon Bedrock's current model card lists this model's lifecycle status as Legacy, with a listed model EOL date of July 7, 2026 that has already passed as of this research date.
advantages: Scores 88.4 ANLS on DocVQA (document visual question answering), per Meta's model card.
Scores 83.4% relaxed accuracy on ChartQA and 91.1% accuracy on AI2 Diagram, per Meta's model card.
Scores 75.2% accuracy on VQAv2 and 50.7% on MMMU, per Meta's model card.
128K-token context window with combined text and image input.
disadvantages: For image+text tasks, only English is supported; text-only tasks additionally support German, French, Italian, Portuguese, Hindi, Spanish, and Thai, per Meta's model card.
Text output only; cannot generate images.
Marked Legacy on Amazon Bedrock's model card, with a listed model EOL date of July 7, 2026 that has already passed as of this research date.
use_cases: Document understanding and document visual question answering (DocVQA).

notes: Catalog's deprecation_date is empty for this target, but Amazon Bedrock's own model card marks this model's lifecycle status as Legacy with a listed model EOL date of July 7, 2026, already past as of the 2026-09-24 research date. Catalog's max_output_tokens (4096) matches Bedrock's listed 4K max output. Meta's own llama.com/developer.meta.com model-card pages redirected to a login screen and could not be read directly, so this write-up relies on Meta's GitHub and Hugging Face model cards plus AWS Bedrock's status page.
